value.rationale: An exact gap at the first noncomplete binary rank-two Grassmann graph is a natural finite-field analogue of existing ordinary Johnson/Hamming neighborhood VC investigations. The 35-vertex strongly regular example supplies a sharp 4-versus-5 static/adaptive contrast and a complete 41160 four-support census, not an arbitrary parameter substitution; it is a concrete benchmark for q-Grassmann neighborhood tameness without asserting a general theorem.
